patch_description:
This crossover retains the higher-scoring current program’s efficient internal horizontal-strip partition plan, avoiding the lower-scoring border-wall construction from the inspiration program.

It improves internal planning in two ways:
1. Each human computes one BFS distance field per turn, then uses exact reachable distances for selecting its next wall position instead of Manhattan distance. This avoids selecting wall-adjacent standing squares that are geometrically close but cut off by already constructed partitions.
2. Human move-target collision rejection is removed. Multiple humans are allowed to occupy the same square by the official rules, so rejecting those moves unnecessarily delayed construction.

The wall legality checks, tentative same-turn wall avoidance, pet-position tracking, simultaneous action model, and interactive I/O protocol are preserved.
